headword: {一攫千金|いっかくせんきん}
gloss: making a fortune at a stroke; striking it rich

definitions.gloss: making a fortune at a stroke; striking it rich; getting rich quick
definitions.explanation: Gaining a large amount of money or wealth all at once through a single opportunity. A four-character idiom (四字熟語). Literally means 'grab a thousand gold pieces in one swoop.'

examples.japanese: {一攫千金|いっかくせんきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{夢見|ゆめみ}る→夢見る：10543_yumemiru⟧。
examples.english: To dream of striking it rich.

examples.japanese: ⟦{宝|たから}くじ→宝くじ：18549_takarakuji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{一攫千金|いっかくせんきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{狙|ねら}う→狙う：00313_nerau⟧。
examples.english: To aim for a big win with the lottery.

examples.japanese: {一攫千金|いっかくせんきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{狙|ねら}って→狙う：00313_nerau⟧⟦{株|かぶ}→株：02592_kabu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{投資|とうし}→投資：04711_toushi⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{大損|おおぞん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I invested in stocks hoping to strike it rich, but ended up with a huge loss.

notes:
A ⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧ (four-character idiom) meaning to get rich in one stroke.

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧ (one) + {攫|かく} (seize/grab) + ⟦{千|せん}→千：00809_sen⟧ (thousand) + {金|きん} (gold) — "grab a thousand gold pieces in one swoop."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一攫千金|いっかくせんきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{夢見|ゆめみ}る→夢見る：10543_yumemiru⟧: to dream of striking it rich
- {一攫千金|いっかくせんきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{狙|ねら}う→狙う：00313_nerau⟧: to aim for a quick fortune
- {一攫千金|いっかくせんきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to get rich quick

USAGE:
Often used with a cautionary tone, implying that such get-rich-quick schemes are risky, unrealistic, or reckless. Commonly appears in contexts about gambling, lotteries, or speculative investments.
The character {攫|かく} (seize) is uncommon outside this idiom.
